reader.requirement: At --std 85 control after START follows IX.1.3.5: on an invalid key the INVALID KEY imperative runs (USE not run, NOT INVALID KEY ignored) or, absent the phrase, the USE procedure; on success NOT INVALID KEY runs if present, its explicit transfers (GO TO) honoured; on a non-invalid-key exception (47) the USE procedure runs and neither phrase.

edition-consulted.switches: EC-I-O checking arm (2002+ >>TURN); at 85 the mask is 0 and the plain format-1 USE arm is taken, the same arm a 2023 program without >>TURN takes

reader.edition-search: grep Edition|DialectLevel|DialectBehavior in SequentialIoEmitter.cs: only NamedRecordEntry (SELECT WHEN, not START); EmitInvalid/EmitPhrasePair read none
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f15_04 covers the six phrase/match combinations with a USE procedure; GO TO out of NOT INVALID KEY and the 47 routing with both phrases present are not exercised

probes.printed: CLOSED-START=47 USES 2 (no CLOSED-INVALID, no CLOSED-NOT-INVALID) / S1-NOT-INVALID / S2-NOT-INVALID / USE-X 23 S3 / S4=00 without S4-FELL-THROUGH / S5-INVALID with USES unchanged
probes.expected: IX.1.3.5: 47 with both phrases -> USE only; success -> NOT INVALID KEY; GO TO P-AFTER in NOT INVALID KEY transfers (no fall-through); invalid key with phrase -> phrase, USE not run; without phrase -> USE

probes.printed: error COBOL0900: a reverse-search START KEY operator ... requires COBOL-2002 (targeting COBOL-85)
probes.expected: KEY IS LESS THAN is not in the 1985 format: refused (also <= in edarm_c3, WITH LENGTH in edarm_c4)

OK  §1985:IX.1.3.5 GR2  (1.3.5 The Invalid Key Condition)  the text is in GR2

reader.notes: EmitPhrasePair renders INVALID KEY on the 2x class and NOT INVALID KEY on the 0x class gated by the hook, so a 47 reaches neither; the USE hook is told invalidKeyHandled so a written INVALID KEY suppresses the declarative.

refuter.evidence: Probe src/s1.cob (s1-001) aimed at USE selection the reader did not try: 47 with both phrases on a never-opened file -> file-name USE only (USE-N 47, no N-INVALID/N-NOT-INVALID); 47 in OUTPUT mode -> USE ... ON OUTPUT only; invalid key without INVALID KEY on an I-O file -> USE ...
